column2: Paano mahanap ang users na may orders gamit ang EXISTS?
column4: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);

column2: Paano mahanap ang users na walang orders?
column4: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);

column2: Paano mag-filter base sa maximum value ng bawat group?
column4: SELECT * FROM orders o WHERE o.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM orders WHERE user_id = o.user_id);

column2: Paano gumamit ng correlated subquery sa SELECT?
column4: SELECT u.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) AS order_count FROM users u;

column2: Paano i-rewrite ang correlated subquery para mas mabilis?
column4: Gamitin ang JOIN o window functions kung posible.
